answer: In PoA, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation verifies the enclave’s MRENCLAVE and a hardware-bound, non-exportable key. MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip, so Sybil resistance also requires validating platform certificates and limiting credentials per eligible device. A VM clone cannot copy the trusted hardware key; creating another identity requires additional genuine silicon, even as agents named comet and timber wander between hosts.
